title: Most Photography Rules Are Old Workarounds. Learn When to Break Them.
excerpt: Shoot wide open, keep ISO low, save landscapes for golden hour. Most of it holds up until a client books a noon ceremony. The rules were built for limits your camera no longer has, and the test is knowing which ones still earn their keep.

title: The Entry-Level Camera Is Dead. Your First Camera Can Be a Real One.
excerpt: Camera makers have stopped selling beginners deliberately crippled cameras. The new OM System PEN, Panasonic Lumix L10, and Nikon Z5IIC give first-time buyers real capability instead of yesterday's technology. Your first camera no longer has to be one you outgrow.

title: A $25 Flash Is the Cheapest Photography Lesson You Can Buy
excerpt: A $24.90 flash that weighs less than an ounce and has four power levels and nothing else. No TTL, no bounce, no excuses. For a photographer learning light, the cheapest flash on the shelf may be the best teacher.
